title: Line Track Record Points — Pocketwire Advance Card Repayment Share
content:
The track record of a Pocketwire Advance line adds points to its card repayment share. When the line was opened at least 730 days before the handling date and at least 6 advances have been disbursed on it, 20 points are added to the share; when it was opened at least 365 days before the handling date and at least 3 advances have been disbursed on it without meeting both parts of the higher test, 10 points are added; otherwise the line's track record adds nothing to the share. A point is one percentage point of the share.

**What is read.** The opening date of the Pocketwire Advance line, counted in calendar days to the handling date, and the number of advances ever disbursed on the line.

## Condition table

| Line opened before the handling date | Advances ever disbursed on the line | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 730 days or more | 6 or more | 20 |
| 730 days or more | 3 to 5 | 10 |
| 365 to 729 days | 3 or more | 10 |
| 365 days or more | Fewer than 3 | Nothing |
| Fewer than 365 days | Any number | Nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Opened exactly 730 days before, 6 advances: 20 points. Opened 729 days before, 6 advances: 10 points.
- Opened exactly 365 days before, 3 advances: 10 points. Opened 364 days before, 10 advances: nothing.
- Opened 900 days before, 2 advances: nothing.
